sourceSentences: If Moonlight is consumed from the target, Lunar Rush's current cooldown is reduced to 0.25 seconds.
Diana dashes to the target enemy's location, and upon completion, she deals them magic damage and consumes Crescent Strike from all enemies.
Diana can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
Lunar Rush consumes Moonlight upon ending the dash (even if interrupted).
If Lunar Rush is blocked by spell shield the Moonlight debuff is still consumed but Lunar Rush's cooldown is not reset.
If all three spheres detonate, Pale Cascade's shield is reapplied, stacking with its original shield and refreshing the duration.
Diana gains bonus attack speed. After casting an ability, this bonus is tripled to for 5 seconds.
At 2 stacks, Diana empowers her next basic attack to consume the stacks on-hit to additionally cleave nearby enemies
Crowd control immunity and displacement immunity still count as being pulled in by the ability.
Moonfall's additional damage is not capped at 4 champions.
Enemy champions protected by spell shield do not count towards the damage increase.
If you use E after Q hits, you can get a second reset of E. You can cast E while Q is traveling. You don't need to wait for Q to hit first to reset the ability.
You can also activate W while Diana is in the air
The main and basic thing is to launch the R combo, launch the R while Diana is moving in the air. This is the fastest way to cast your ultimate
The first one we're going to look at is Q plus flash plus E R.
Always launch the Q before the flash to do it as quickly as possible.
Basic combo: Q, then W and E. Then just attack, using E to chase.
And for team combat: Q, E and ult. Use W during attacks and E again if needed.
Jumping onto a target with a Q tag resets E's cooldown.
And if all three explode, she gets the shield again.
After using the skill, this bonus is tripled for 5 seconds, which is very significant.
